description: This file defines the TransactionAttribute class, transaction options enums, and various abstract classes related to transaction requests and responses within the Orleans framework. It includes attributes for marking transactional methods, enums for transaction modes, and base classes for handling transaction logic, serialization, and method invocation.

classes.name: TransactionAttribute
classes.description: Attribute used to mark methods that start and join transactions, with options for requirement modes and aliases.

classes.name: TransactionOption
classes.description: Enum defining various transaction modes such as Suppress, CreateOrJoin, Create, Join, Supported, and NotAllowed.

classes.name: TransactionOptionAlias
classes.description: Enum providing alias names for transaction options, mapping to TransactionOption values.

classes.name: TransactionRequestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for transaction requests, handling serialization, transaction context management, and invocation logic.

classes.name: TransactionResponse
classes.description: Class representing the response of a transaction, including transaction info and inner response.

classes.name: TransactionRequest
classes.description: Abstract class for transaction requests with no result, handling invocation and completion logic.

classes.name: TransactionRequest<TResult>
classes.description: Abstract class for transaction requests with a result, handling invocation and result processing.

classes.name: TransactionTaskRequest<TResult>
classes.description: Abstract class for transaction requests returning a Task<TResult>, handling invocation and result processing.

classes.name: TransactionTaskRequest
classes.description: Abstract class for transaction requests returning a Task, handling invocation and completion.

methods.name: TransactionAttribute
methods.description: Constructors for setting transaction requirement or alias.

methods.name: SetTransactionOptions
methods.description: Methods to set transaction options using enum or alias.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Main method to invoke the transaction request, managing transaction lifecycle and response.

methods.name: BaseInvoke
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to perform the actual invocation.

methods.name: CompleteInvokeAsync
methods.description: Helper method to await a ValueTask and produce a Response.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the transaction request, clearing transaction info.

methods.name: OnDeserialized
methods.description: Reinitializes serializers and transaction agent after deserialization.
